S31.01.needs: a text document artifact (create one in chat first, or use an existing one)
S31.01.note: Expected names Word, text and markdown inputs; the code offers PDF only for document artifacts, and the download menu trigger label was not confirmed. The quoted managed-office-file-service code moved and was not found.
steps: From the first screen after sign-in, click Library in the sidebar and open a saved text document (a document-type artifact).
Open the artifact's download menu in its preview (the menu that holds Download as HTML, Download as Markdown).
Click Download as PDF. The option appears only for document artifacts that are not Word or PDF files.
Compare with Expected: a PDF file should download. Also check Export as PDF in the library export menu, which lists PDF when the artifact allows it.
S31.01.where: Library > open a text document artifact > its download menu > Download as PDF

S31.02.note: No spreadsheet-to-PDF option was found. The PDF options are only for document artifacts and presentations (ArtifactPreview.tsx), and the support page apps/web/content/support/artifacts.md says there is no spreadsheet export on web. Spreadsheet export offers Excel only (ArtifactRenderer.tsx). Searched for the PDF labels and for container-files.ts usage.

S31.03.needs: a presentation artifact (create a slide deck in chat first)
S31.03.note: The audit's partial status refers to the E2B office template build script (apps/web/scripts/build-e2b-office-template.mjs), which is not needed for the deck export path found here. Page-per-slide layout was not checked.
steps: From the first screen after sign-in, click Library in the sidebar and open a saved presentation (slide deck) artifact.
Open the artifact's download menu in its preview.
Click Download as PDF. The export runs through the local deck PDF code (presentation/deck-pdf) and shows the toast Preparing the PDF.
Compare with Expected: the PDF should download with one page per slide. Toast text: PDF downloaded.
S31.03.where: Library > open a presentation artifact > its download menu > Download as PDF

S31.04.note: The visible attach button label was not located, so the tester may need to look for the paper-clip or attach icon by eye. The text comes from apps/web/lib/server/pdf-attachment-content.ts.
steps: From the first screen after sign-in, start a new chat.
Attach a PDF using the attachment control in the message box. The hidden file input is labelled File upload; its visible button label was not found.
Type a request such as Summarize this PDF, then send the message.
Compare with Expected: the answer should be a summary of the PDF content. A PDF attachment also opens a preview in the message.
S31.04.where: New chat > attach a PDF with the attachment control in the message box > type a request for a summary > send

S31.05.needs: a PDF file saved in the Library
S31.05.note: The support page apps/web/content/support/artifacts.md describes this box; the answer logic is in apps/web/lib/server/pdf-attachment-content.ts.
steps: From the first screen after sign-in, click Library in the sidebar and select a PDF file that was saved there.
In the viewer, click the Ask about this file box at the bottom.
Type a question about the PDF content and send it. A new chat opens with the file attached and the question written.
Compare with Expected: the answer should use facts from the PDF.
S31.05.where: Library > select a PDF file > Ask about this file > type a question > send

S31.06.needs: a multi-page PDF file saved in the Library
S31.06.note: No page picker control was found; page targeting depends on the question text and on the [Page n] markers in apps/web/lib/server/pdf-attachment-content.ts. Very long documents are cut at a text page cap.
steps: From the first screen after sign-in, click Library and select a multi-page PDF.
In the Ask about this file box, type a question that names a page, for example What does page 3 say?
Send the question and wait for the new chat to answer.
Compare with Expected: the answer should match the text of that page. The page content is marked [Page n] in the extracted text.
S31.06.where: Library > select a PDF file > Ask about this file > type a question naming a page > send

S31.07.needs: a PDF file with selectable text
S31.07.note: No dedicated extract-text button was found. Text comes through chat-attachment-hydration.ts, and a long document may be cut at the text page cap, so the reply can be partial.
steps: From the first screen after sign-in, click Library and select a PDF file.
In the Ask about this file box, type a request such as Give me the plain text of this PDF, then send it.
Compare with Expected: the reply should contain the document's text in plain form.
S31.07.where: Library > select a PDF file > Ask about this file > type a request for the full text > send

S31.08.note: There is no OCR button; recognition happens when the model reads the page image, as described at apps/web/lib/server/pdf-attachment-content.ts (scanned page, attached as an image).
steps: Click Library, select a scanned PDF (image-only pages), and use the Ask about this file box to ask for its text.
Compare with Expected: the reply should contain readable text from the scanned pages. A page that is only an image is sent to the model as an image.
S31.08.where: Shows in the answer when a scanned PDF is asked about (Library > select scanned PDF > Ask about this file)

S31.09.note: No table-specific control or structured table output was found in the UI. Searched container-files.ts and chat-attachment-hydration.ts for table handling and the UI for table export; the only export options seen are PDF, Word and Excel for artifacts.

S31.24.note: Office previews for pptx and xlsx come from apps/web/features/chat/lib/office-file-preview.ts. Whether the PDF matches the preview was not checked, and text documents export without a preview first.
steps: From the first screen after sign-in, open a chat that produced a presentation or document artifact and open it in the artifact panel.
Look at the preview shown before export (presentation slides or document view).
Open the download menu and click Download as PDF.
Compare with Expected: the downloaded PDF should match the preview. For documents there is no separate preview step before the file downloads.
S31.24.where: Chat > open a presentation or Word artifact in the artifact panel > its preview > download menu > Download as PDF
